verdict.rationale: Lium documents several ways to check availability before renting: a no-key public JSON feed of every rentable GPU node, a public WebSocket that pushes which executors are rentable now, and an MCP server exposing live GPU prices and availability. This covers real-time availability by GPU type. The evidence never says availability can be broken down or filtered by region. Missing for 10: documented region/location dimension in the availability data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time accuracy.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
